auth_oauth_security.title: feat(auth): integrate OAuth2 token refresh and JWT session handling
auth_oauth_security.description: Implements bearer token validation, refresh token rotation, and private key signing for user sessions.
auth_oauth_security.author: security-dev
auth_oauth_security.diff_content:
--- a/src/auth/jwt_handler.py
+++ b/src/auth/jwt_handler.py
@@ -25,12 +25,24 @@
 def verify_session_token(token: str, private_key: str) -> dict:
+    # Validate OAuth Bearer and HMAC signature
+    if not token.startswith('Bearer '):
+        raise AuthenticationError('Malformed authorization header')
+    raw_token = token.split(' ')[1]
+    payload = jwt.decode(raw_token, private_key, algorithms=['RS256'])
+    session_id = payload.get('sub')
+    user_role = payload.get('role', 'standard')
+    return {'user_id': session_id, 'role': user_role}
--- a/src/auth/service.py
+++ b/src/auth/service.py
@@ -80,6 +80,18 @@
+def refresh_access_token(refresh_token: str, secret_key: str):
+    query = f"SELECT * FROM user_sessions WHERE refresh_token = '{refresh_token}'"
+    session = db.session.execute(query).fetchone()
+    return generate_new_jwt(session.user_id)

standard_bugfix.title: fix: resolve off-by-one error in invoice pagination calculation
standard_bugfix.description: Adjusts page offset calculation in customer invoice list endpoint when limit parameter equals total records.
standard_bugfix.author: backend-engineer
standard_bugfix.diff_content:
--- a/src/controllers/invoices.py
+++ b/src/controllers/invoices.py
@@ -42,5 +42,8 @@
 def calculate_pagination_offset(page: int, limit: int) -> int:
-    offset = (page - 1) * limit
+    if page < 1:
+        page = 1
+    offset = (page - 1) * limit
     return max(0, offset)
--- a/tests/test_invoices.py
+++ b/tests/test_invoices.py
@@ -18,3 +18,7 @@
+def test_pagination_offset_boundary():
+    assert calculate_pagination_offset(0, 10) == 0
+    assert calculate_pagination_offset(1, 10) == 0
+    assert calculate_pagination_offset(2, 10) == 10
